coding.mutable-default.root_cause: The function uses a shared mutable default argument, so state leaks across calls.
coding.mutable-default.patch: Change the parameter default to None and initialize a new list inside the function.
tests: Call the function twice without a list and assert the second result starts empty.
Pass an explicit list and assert it is still used.

visual.overflow.root_cause: A fixed 720px child plus padding exceeds the 390px mobile viewport.
visual.overflow.patch: Use minmax(0, 1fr), set child min-width to 0, and allow long content to wrap.
